Abbreviated reference to&nbsp;[[The Complete Lojban Language]] that describes the reference grammar of Lojban. It's a usual abbreviation in the Lojban community because it is to date the main Lojban textbook.

Also known jocularly as the&nbsp;[[Codex Woldemar]], & Lojbanically as''la braxu'e ('Big Red Thing'), or''le gencukta''.''

Also known as the "Woldy Codex" or "The Woldy"

Also known, unjocularly, as "The Refgram" (i.e. reference grammar).
